title: TinyLM — Local LLM Inference Service
description: High-performance, low-memory local AI inference microservice (RAM capped at ≤ 2 GB). Exposes an OpenAPI-compliant REST API built with FastAPI executing quantized LLM models (Qwen2.5-1.5B GGUF) via llama-cpp-python on Alpine Linux containers.
highlights: Multi-stage Docker architecture on Alpine Linux minimizing image size and attack surface.
Inference endpoints compliant with standard OpenAI format (/v1/chat/completions) and health check (/health).
Lazy loading strategy and idempotent GGUF model binary ingestion from Hugging Face.

title: Unity 2D Multiplayer .NET Backend Template
description: Enterprise C# & .NET 9 boilerplate architecture with SignalR for 2D multiplayer games and spatial virtual environments in Unity. Handles presence, movement, and spatial messaging in real time.
highlights: Real-time WebSocket synchronization using SignalR with spatial room grouping support.
Cross-platform automation scripts extracting official SignalR .NET Standard 2.1 client DLLs into Unity.
Architected with Clean Architecture, EF Core, Redis Backplane support, and full Docker containerization.

title: RESTful Task API (Clean Architecture)
description: Containerized RESTful task management API built with FastAPI and Python 3.12, architected around Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles for strict decoupling.
highlights: Four-layer Clean Architecture design (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, API Presentation Layer).
Relational database modeling with SQLModel (SQLAlchemy + Pydantic) and SQLite/PostgreSQL persistence.
Automated unit & integration test suites using pytest and reproducible Docker Compose orchestration.

title: Sorting Algorithms & Memory Benchmarks (.NET 10)
description: High-performance modular C# library in .NET 10 implementing fundamental sorting algorithms and data structures. Architected with Clean Architecture, generic constraints, xUnit tests, and BenchmarkDotNet profiling.
highlights: Decoupled generic implementations of QuickSort, MergeSort, HeapSort, InsertionSort, TimSort, and BubbleSort.
CPU runtime profiling and microsecond-level memory allocation benchmarks using BenchmarkDotNet.
Exhaustive parameterized unit testing suite with xUnit and FluentAssertions.

title: Low-Latency WebSocket Server Engine
description: High-concurrency, low-latency bidirectional real-time WebSocket communication engine built with C# and .NET, tailored for event streaming and rapid data exchange.
highlights: Asynchronous high-throughput lifecycle management for concurrent socket connections.
Lightweight payload messaging protocol to minimize CPU overhead and network bandwidth.
Modular architecture designed for direct integration into distributed backend microservices.
